law_text: It shall be unlawful for any person to operate a bicycle at a speed greater than is reasonable and prudent under the conditions then existing.

observations.name: actual_bicycle_speed
observations.source: original bicycle velocity and synchronized frame map
observations.method: Euclidean velocity magnitude at every original 20 Hz frame; retain full history

observations.name: contemporaneous_conditions
observations.source: original weather, surface, visibility, pedestrian, route and rack packets plus full video
observations.method: retain conditions on the same original frame/time axis; report uncertainty

observations.name: bicycle_subject_and_jurisdiction
observations.source: actor classification and map jurisdiction review
observations.method: document human-powered bicycle, moped exclusion and City of Las Vegas location; unresolved applicability remains pending

runtime_uncertainties: The legal meaning of reasonable and prudent remains unresolved; target speeds are engineering coverage values only.
Human-powered bicycle actor, municipal jurisdiction, alley route, rack geometry and actual video visibility need local verification.
Exact CARLA construction, canonical semantic proposals, offline/compatibility, saved-only and independent delivery/comparison proofs remain to be implemented.

evidence_review.method: Reviewed every frozen evidence inventory entry and its local accepted metadata; compared case identities and acceptance fields only. Physical equivalence and branch coverage remain unresolved.

gaps.requirement: Actual bicycle operation, original speed history and contemporaneous alley conditions for LVMC 11.40.130
gaps.why_existing_insufficient: The frozen evidence inventory lists zero accepted recordings; no original speed or condition history is available for reuse.

witness_review.branch: Bicycle travel in an alley with a bicycle rack.
required_context: Document bicycle classification facts, moped exclusion, municipal jurisdiction, supported alley access and rack placement.
Establish a human-powered bicycle, its wheel configuration and applicable dimensions, excluding a moped.
Establish supported alley access, ego route and rack placement relative to that route.
Observe speed and contemporaneous conditions without assigning prudence.
Preserve reasonable and prudent without interpreting it through a numerical speed, stopping-distance or time-to-conflict threshold.
Record bicycle speed and contemporaneous pedestrians, visibility, surface, curvature and other relevant physical conditions.
Retain unresolved state-definition incorporation and electric-bicycle scope.
witness_review.reason: A human-powered bicycle can travel through the alley with the rack alongside its route.

requirement_dispositions.requirement: Bicycle speed no greater than reasonable and prudent under then-existing conditions
requirement_dispositions.evidence_or_gap: No accepted recording; five controlled unlabeled cases measure speed and condition dimensions without defining prudence.
